entities.name: Snapjaw
entities.description: A snapjaw modified by Golgari and Izzet, found injured and healed by the Simic, which begins developing humanoid features and sapience and longs to go home.

entities.name: Kelen Jek
entities.description: Mechanoaugmentation Specialist, Third Class, who submits Trial Proposal #1547.

entities.name: Stanisil
entities.description: Simic biomancer of Hull Clade who incubates and studies the snapjaw and asks it to record its thoughts.

entities.name: Speaker Trifon
entities.description: Simic speaker to whom Stanisil reports.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The biomancer guild that cares for and studies the creature.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The guild whose rot farm and sewage reclamation the drudge-monitor oversees; its raising is suggested for the snapjaw.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild whose tinkering reinforced the snapjaw's skeleton and whose territory the drudge-monitor would herd it into.

events.summary: A snapjaw enters the Golgari rot farm and fights and eats nonstop.
events.quote: A snapjaw made its way into the rot farm today

events.summary: The snapjaw eats two workers and a handler, so the drudge-monitor plans to herd it into Izzet territory.
Kelen Jek proposes a trial combining neuroamplification serum with a mechanical augmentation implant.
events.quote: Can a neuroamplification serum be applied to a subject in concert with an implanted mechanical augmentation

events.summary: A badly injured creature is found on the Northern Interior coast and coaxed into incubation by Stanisil to be healed.
events.quote: We coaxed it into incubation in order to heal it, and an unexpected set of reactions began.

events.summary: Stanisil removes most Izzet mechanisms from the snapjaw, which begins to develop humanoid features and near-sapience.
events.quote: I believe that it is on the verge of demonstrating sapience.

events.summary: The creature, now with hands, records its feelings, resents being studied and fears its freedom.
events.quote: I am being studied, and I do not like it.

events.summary: The creature recalls a kind human boy and resolves to go home.
events.quote: I want to go home. And I think I remember the way.

relations.quote: I am pleased to inform you of the results of a series of projects that have recently come to an end.

relations.note: Cared for and studied by Stanisil.
relations.quote: Stanisil has asked me to record my thoughts and feelings as I, and they, develop.
